summary.tldr: Requires a national soil conservation strategy and creates World Soil Day and National Soil Conservation Week in Canada.
what_it_does: Requires the Minister of Agriculture and Agri-Food to develop a national strategy to conserve soil and improve soil health across Canada.
Requires the strategy to include soil assessments, ongoing data collection, support for best management practices, knowledge sharing, and recommendations on a national advocate for soil health.
Requires the minister to consult provincial agriculture officials, Indigenous governments and organisations, and agriculture industry stakeholders when developing the strategy.
Requires the minister to table the strategy report in Parliament within two years, then report every three years on how the strategy is working.
Names December 5 as World Soil Day and the third week of April as National Soil Conservation Week across Canada.
